mobile.signin-subtitle: Use your account email and password.
mobile.signin-not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
mobile.today-pending: {count, plural, one {# recording waiting to be sent} other {# recordings waiting to be sent}}

mobile.capture-blocked-kept: The audio is kept on the phone. Resolve the reason above and try again.
mobile.unlock-hint: Confirm your identity to access clinical data on this device.
mobile.mfa-hint: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
mobile.mfa-failed: The code could not be verified. Try again.

mobile.settings-biometric-unavailable: Biometrics are unavailable or not enrolled on this device.
mobile.settings-notifications-hint: Receive generic alerts only, with no names or clinical content.
mobile.settings-notifications-failed: Status alerts could not be configured.
mobile.settings-notifications-permission_denied: Allow notifications in the system settings.
mobile.settings-notifications-configuration_mis: Notifications are not configured in this build yet.
mobile.settings-notifications-registration_fail: This device could not be registered.
mobile.capture-mode-title: How should this recording be used?

mobile.capture-error-not_authorized: Your session cannot access this consultation. Sign in again.
mobile.capture-error-recording_too_large: The recording reached the 512 MiB limit.
mobile.capture-error-generic: The audio remains protected on this device. Try again.
mobile.capture-leave-hint: Finish the recording before leaving this screen.
mobile.capture-limit-warning: Automatic stop is less than 10 minutes away.

mobile.capture-pending-notification: A recording is waiting to be uploaded.
